basis: Deterministic pure 60Hz simulation, not browser input or human difficulty assessment.
inspectedCommit: 2829de2 with AI-G implementation in the working tree; exact source hashes below
comparisonBaseline: docs/reviews/evidence/h1-ai-baseline.json retained unchanged; identical player policy and standard starting rules
randomness: No RNG or seed in approved AI; each unchanged standard-start policy repeated 3 times byte-equivalent.

policy.stand-guard: away axis held, standing; includes normal backward movement
policy.approach-grab-repeat: public distance >96: walk toward; when own visible action is free and grounded at distance<=96: fresh U/I down together, up next tick; otherwise neutral. Frame-perfect scripted timing, no manual HP/position injection.

logging.basicCommands: CPU input selections, including a same-tick capture or interruption before an attack remains visible
logging.observableBasicStarts: New attack instance visible after common resolution
logging.blockedHits: Blocked contacts indexed by attacker, not successful guards by that side
logging.grabEscapesByTarget: Escape events indexed by grabbed target
logging.combatTime: Playing ticks only, excludes KO result animation and manual transition time
logging.drawLimit: After 5 attempts stop observation; the engine remains in round-result and no victor is fabricated
logging.timelineFrames: frame is the post-tick combat.frame (first processed tick is 1); grab age0 is H0 at capture. before state is priorFrame. Logs may inspect ages, but the scripted policy does not use them.
